scripts.dev: npm run build:ui && cf dev --mode development
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && cf build --mode staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:ui && cf deploy --mode staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:ui && cf deploy --mode production
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:ui && npm run types && tsc --noEmit
scripts.d1:migrate:production: cf d1 migrations apply postfalcon-production --dir migrations
